description: Pick one or more items at random from a list you send, with or without repeats. The list is yours, so this is the unbiased chooser an agent needs when it has options and no reason to prefer any. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

count.description: How many to pick, 1-100. Defaults to 1.

items.description: The options, comma-separated. A JSON array of strings is also accepted in a POST body.

repeat.description: Allow the same item more than once. Defaults to false.

name: random_pick
title: Random pick
